role: Draws the targeted block's selection outline (RenderGlobal.drawSelectionBox: the box grown by 0.002, 12 two-pixel lines darkening the frame to 60%) and the block-breaking crack overlay (RenderGlobal.drawBlockDamageTexture: the block re-meshed with the destroy_stage_N icon and blended 2*src*dst) over a finished frame. Both passes are fogged as renderWorld leaves GL_FOG on (the line toward the fog colour at alpha 0.4, the crack texel before its blend): a selection or crack under water or lava fades into the fog.
gpu: line 173, function crack: linear strcmp search of the atlas name table for destroy_stage_N on every call
notes: Called from raster.c. Uses rb_mesh_override_block from the block mesher and raster_texture_sample for the mipmapped crack texel. Line rasterization approximates GL wide lines (diamond-exit endpoint rule, width two).
